mapper.sql: SELECT t.*, s.full_name AS student_name, u.full_name AS therapist_name FROM therapy_sessions t JOIN students s ON s.id = t.student_id JOIN users u ON u.id = t.therapist_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO therapy_sessions (student_id, therapist_id, therapy_type, start_time, end_time, location, status, notes) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{therapistId}, #{therapyType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{location}, #{status}, #{notes})
